section: Civil services in India - role, neutrality, generalist-specialist debate; Second ARC recommendations
subsections: Mission Karmayogi - iGOT, Capacity Building Commission

accepted.s: The National Programme for Civil Services Capacity Building, launched in 2020, is associated with which online platform?
accepted.x: The National Programme for Civil Services Capacity Building was launched in 2020 with the iGOT Karmayogi online platform.
accepted.tq: Identify the exact programme-platform association rather than choosing a related institutional name.
accepted.sec: Mission Karmayogi - iGOT, Capacity Building Commission

accepted.s: Which institution is the custodian of Mission Karmayogi?
o: National Programme for Civil Services Capacity Building
accepted.x: The Capacity Building Commission is the custodian of Mission Karmayogi.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the institution responsible for custody from the programme, platform and alliance associated with it.
accepted.sec: Mission Karmayogi - iGOT, Capacity Building Commission

accepted.s: The Global Digital Capacity Building Alliance was launched at which of the following places and events?
o: New Delhi at the India AI Impact Summit
Hyderabad at the India AI Governance Summit
Amaravati at the State of Capacity Building Summit
New Delhi at the annual Capacity Building Summit
accepted.x: The Global Digital Capacity Building Alliance was launched in New Delhi on 20 February 2026 at the India AI Impact Summit.
accepted.tq: Link the exact date, venue and event instead of relying on a familiar institutional name.
accepted.sec: Mission Karmayogi - iGOT, Capacity Building Commission

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the Global Digital Capacity Building Alliance:
1. It completed six months.
2. An annual summit is planned.
3. A State of Capacity Building Report is planned.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct: the Alliance completed six months, and an annual summit and a State of Capacity Building Report are planned.
accepted.tq: Check each current-affairs statement independently before selecting the combined option.

accepted.s: In the context of Andhra Pradesh, disciplinary action against civil servants is associated with which rules and date?
accepted.x: The Andhra Pradesh angle concerns disciplinary action under the AP CCA Rules, 1991, reported on 21 April 2026.
accepted.tq: Separate the exact rule title and year from closely similar rule names and dates.

accepted.s:
Civil servants perform which of the following roles in public administration?
1. Policy advisers
2. Implementers of public policy
3. Stabilisers of the administrative system
Select the correct answer using the code given below.
accepted.x: Civil servants serve as policy advisers, implementers and stabilisers in public administration; therefore, all three statements are correct.
accepted.tq: Recognise the complementary roles of civil servants instead of treating advice, implementation and stability as mutually exclusive.
